Timelines collide in the next chapter of the Friendsim story! After befriending the weird and wild trolls of Hiveswap Friendsim, it’s time to meet some kids a little closer to home. Zap to Earth to meet new friends in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144030/Pesterquest/]Pesterquest,[/url] the next visual novel in the Homestuck universe.

Your favorite artists, writers and musicians return from Hiveswap Friendsim, with new talent joining their ranks as the 14-volume tale unfolds. Start making friends and messing up canon on September 4th with the first two volumes by Andrew Hussie and Aysha U. Farah.

This time around, you can make every friend in one affordable bundle. That’s 20 incredible characters and 14 total volumes for just $12!

If you’re excited for this universe-crossing friend ‘em up, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144030/Pesterquest/]wishlist us on Steam.[/url] Happy pestering!

https://youtu.be/pGYHRm5otCU

notes.title: What Pumpkin and Fellow Traveller team up for an adventure!
notes.notes:
We're delighted to announce that Fellow Traveller is our newest adventure buddy! Fellow Traveller is an indie publisher that focuses on surprising narrative games. You may remember them as the hosts of LudoNarraCon, the publisher of indie darling games Orwell and Hacknet, or their upcoming games Church in the Darkness and NeoCab.

First things first: What Pumpkin will continue to focus on all aspects of game development such as art, writing, music, and so very much more. Meanwhile, Fellow Traveller will be managing all of the business bits: think marketing, brand management, and production support.

We’ve done this so we can devote more of our time to the development of the game. So what does this mean for you? In short: we’re working hard to bring Act 2 to the world as soon as possible. With our new partner, it also means you'll be hearing from us a lot more: look forward to regular updates, newsletters, social media posts, and more exciting news in the coming weeks. In the meantime, you're all invited to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ASu4zZb]official Discord server.[/url] We look forward to meeting you all there!

[url=https://discord.gg/ASu4zZb][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025617/08911c80e2620eae00805e1dcf4fba33126c94d5.png[/img][/url]

And now, we’ll get back to implementing all these assets…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025617/55916d3ab569d3712c823ceb6e538750d2b19c35.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.5 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Happy 2018, everyone! We hope you’re still having a wonderful time playing HIVESWAP: Act 1 and exploring every last corner of Half-Harley Manor… and beyond! We have a new patch for you today, which addresses the following:

- AVPro has been updated, which should fix some crashes related to video playback that have been reported recently
- Fixes a bug that occurs when clicking on the Walkie-Talkie icon while simultaneously exiting a room

We hope this patch resolves any issues you may have encountered related to the above and apologize for any inconvenience caused in the interim. Thank you for your continued support of HIVESWAP: Act 1!

notes.title: MINOR LINUX VERSION UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We can't thank you enough for your continued support of HIVESWAP: Act 1 and we hope you're having a blast with the game. We just pushed a minor update specifically for the Linux version of HIVESWAP: Act 1 that addresses the following issues:

- Fixed a bug related to the spice mix not appearing properly in the intro cutscene to the kitchen strife 

- Fixed a bug that would cause Joey to appear twice during the intro cutscene to the kitchen strife

That's all for today! We hope these bug fixes improve the gameplay experience for those Linux players who encountered them, and we apologize for any inconvenience they may have caused.

notes.title: V1.3 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
We promised it, you’ve been asking for it, and now it’s here – today’s new patch officially adds Linux support to HIVESWAP: Act 1!

That’s right, you read that correctly – Linux users, your time has come! We can’t thank you enough for your continued patience on this front, and we’re excited to deliver Linux support so more players can open the door and get started on their HIVESWAP adventure!

But the addition of Linux support isn’t the only update this patch brings. Here’s what we addressed in this patch:

- Linux support added
- In-game text will now only advance when you click the mouse, press the Enter key, or press the space bar, making it easy to take screenshots without further advancing the text
- Various typo fixes

Thank you so much for your continued support of HIVESWAP: Act 1 – we’re thrilled to see so many players continuing to enjoy the game and explore every last corner of it!

notes.title: V1.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who helped make the launch of HIVESWAP: Act 1 a success! Your support means the world to us, and your enthusiasm for the game and the story we’re telling has been amazing. 

Since release day, we’ve been working on fixes for some cutscene and resolution issues players have been experiencing. We have released a patch that should address these issues for most players. 

Here is some of what was changed in this patch: 

Cutscene playback improvements
Changes to resolution on first run of game
More resolution options available in video dropdown
Various text fixes
Strife white-screen hang fixed
Basement tablet interaction issues fixed

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - HIVESWAP: Act 1
notes.notes:
HIVESWAP: Act 1 is Now Available on Steam!

A hand-drawn tribute to hilarious '90s adventure games (with none of the accompanying frustration). Play as Joey Claire, a puzzle-solving teen snatched out of her time (1994) and place (Earth) and stranded on a hostile alien planet on the brink of rebellion.
